Name: Wishing Well
Author: DominickLim4
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Wishing Well[/b] adds a new mystical farm building that turns gold offerings into randomized rewards.
Purchase the Wishing Well from Robin, choose where to build it on your farm, and wait for construction to finish. Once completed, you can interact with the well and offer between [b]100g and 5,000g[/b].[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Your offering is consumed immediately, and the well will process your wish overnight. Return the following morning and you may find something waiting for you.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
The amount of gold you offer directly affects the rarity distribution of your reward. Every additional 100g improves your odds gradually, rather than using fixed reward brackets.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Rewards are divided into five rarity tiers:
[b]Common → Uncommon → Rare → Epic → Legendary[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Higher offerings can produce valuable minerals, bars, gems, resources, special consumables and exceptionally rare jackpot rewards — but even a maximum offering never guarantees the best possible result.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
When a reward is ready, the well comes alive with magical effects and displays the actual reward floating above it. Collecting the reward uses Stardew Valley's item-holding animation, so your farmer raises the item above their head while rarity-specific particles, colors, sounds and dialogue accompany the reveal.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI
2. Download Wishing Well
3. Extract the mod into:[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code][color=#D4D4D8]4. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI [/color]
